quest.title: Drills by Lamplight
quest.description: A Millelith soldier seems to be troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Minglan
dialogues.text: Surely that Sergeant isn't the one in charge... Well, good luck to them, then, they're gonna need it...

dialogues.speaker: Minglan
dialogues.text: You scared me there! I thought the Sergeant had come over. If he overheard me, I'd get dragged away for more training...

choices.text: Do you guys... still have to train?

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Well, the bigger the festival, the busier we are.

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Liyue Harbor is huge, and there are so many tourists coming in from all over the world.

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: To maintain order and ensure everyone's safety, the Millelith have set up quite a few new mobile units both in the city and in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Do you know what a mobile unit is? Hmm... just think of it as a team of Millelith soldiers who provide help wherever they go.

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: As long as you need help, just run up to a squad and ask for assistance, and they'll lend a hand.

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Whether if you're in danger, lost something, or even got lost yourself, just go ask them for help.

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: But... since we need to cover such a large area, our Sergeant has even pulled out the reserve units that were originally on standby for training.

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: But those reserve units are all made up of rookies who haven't had much training. So the Sergeant said, why not hold a temporary training event to up their individual skill level?

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: I heard that... that particular Sergeant is really tough. Anyone who's been trained by him can't help but shiver when hearing his name...

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: I—I suppose you could say that. His training is actually really effective, but my legs turn into jelly at the mere thought of it...

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Want to give it a try? During my training, I heard him mention your name a lot. He said you're not only a master of tactical deployment, but also excel at hand-to-hand combat...

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Were it you in the training arena, you'd definitely out-perform all of us.

choices.text: I'd love to give it a try!

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Alright. The courage you display... You're indeed the hero of Liyue. Then please, follow me.

choices.text: Let me think it over a bit...

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: That's alright. Just let me know when you want to give it a whirl. I'm sure the Sergeant would be more than happy to have you.
